en.description:
Find the flow. Light the universe.

Rotate glowing glass prisms, connect every path of light and awaken a living constellation. Astrefract is a tactile spatial puzzle for calm play, clever experimentation and that satisfying moment when every beam comes alive.

MADE TO UNFOLD ON IPHONE DUO
Move from the outer screen to an expansive inner playfield without losing your place. Adaptive layouts make room for your game, while Prism Deck gives you a selected-prism preview, direction controls and a dedicated Rotate button in supported folded poses. Swap Sides to put the playfield where it feels right. The inner display rotates with you; the outer display stays comfortably upright in portrait.

LIGHT YOU CAN ALMOST TOUCH
Prism Glass brings soft surface ripples, rounded icy edges, glowing beams and gently bending reflections to every tile. On supported iPhone and iPad devices, tilt to see the highlights respond. Drifting stars, colourful nebula glows and passing space travellers bring the universe behind the glass to life.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• 200 handcrafted refractions, from welcoming 4×4 patterns to challenging mastery boards
• A new Daily Refraction with fair speed-and-move scoring and Game Center rankings
• Precision Targets for an extra challenge, plus gentle hints and Nova assists
• Automatic visuals for balanced play, full Prism Glass or simpler Basic tiles—your choice
• Clear menus that adapt to screen size, orientation and supported system text sizes
• Touch and compatible game-controller input, with mouse and keyboard play on Mac
• iCloud progress across iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV
• Separate music and game-sound controls

MORE WAYS TO ALIGN
Enjoy a compact 4×4 Mini Refraction on Apple Watch, or play on the big screen with Apple TV and a Siri Remote or compatible controller. Collect Cosmic ranks, badges and relics, and return to earlier refractions to improve your stars and scores.

FREE TO START—NO PRESSURE
The first 24 handcrafted refractions and Daily Refraction are free. No forced ads, energy timers, loot boxes or recurring charges.

ASTREFRACT DELUXE
One permanent purchase unlocks 176 more handcrafted refractions, zoomable Endless Deep Space 8×8–16×16 grids, expanded ranks and collectibles, extra themes, unlimited hints, up to 10 Daily retries and future core chapters. Family Sharing is supported, and purchases can be restored on supported devices using your Apple Account.
en.releaseNotes:
Go deeper in Endless Deep Space. Pinch to zoom and drag to explore without turning tiles by accident. Prism turns feel more responsive, and the board fades softly at the edges as you explore.

Play in your language. On iPhone and iPad, choose Language in Audio & Visuals or follow your device's preferred language. This update adds Spanish (Spain and Latin America), French, German, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Indonesian, Hindi and Arabic.

We've also polished audio controls, navigation and animation while keeping the familiar glow and reflections of Prism Glass.

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
• Choose Automatic, Custom Glass or Basic prism tiles in Audio & Visuals.
• Clearer connections when Reduce Transparency or high glass tint is enabled.
• Improved rendering efficiency and adaptive visual quality.
• Renderer and audio preferences sync through iCloud.
• Better-fitting tutorials, menus and text on compact windows and larger text sizes.
• Discreet version information and optional App Store update notices on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

Astrefract 1.1: a bigger universe, made to unfold.

NEW ON IPHONE DUO
• Continue between the outer and inner displays without losing your game.
• Enjoy an expanded inner-screen playfield and layouts designed around the fold.
• Use Prism Deck's selected-prism preview, direction pad and Rotate button in supported folded poses.
• Swap Sides and rotate the inner display to find your comfortable way to play. The outer display stays in portrait.

A NEW SHINE FOR EVERY REFRACTION
• Richer Prism Glass with gently rippled surfaces, rounded icy edges, brighter beams and glowing nodes.
• Tilt-responsive highlights on supported iPhone and iPad devices.
• Drifting stars, colourful nebula glows, shooting stars and passing space objects.
• Smoother rendering, tile movement and layout transitions, with balanced performance and energy use.

POLISH ACROSS YOUR APPLE DEVICES
• More consistent menu sizes, spacing, alignment and soft scrolling edges.
• Compact Audio & Visuals controls with clearer Automatic, Prism Glass and Basic choices.
• Centred Deluxe and completion cards with gentle animations and softly blurred backgrounds.
• Improved Apple Watch playfield, Back button, clock clearance, beam colours and rotation animation.
• Clearer Mac menus and game information, plus better Apple TV remote navigation.

FIXES THAT KEEP YOU PLAYING
• Return safely after dismissing Deluxe at the end of Refraction 24.
• Improved touch input, Back buttons, stacked precision banners, timers and orientation handling.
• Better fitting menus and playfields across supported screen sizes.

Go deeper in Endless Deep Space. Pinch to zoom and drag to explore without turning tiles by accident. Prism turns feel more responsive, and the board fades softly at the edges as you explore.
